values: Irreducibility of exposed-point varieties of discotopes — Alec Kriebel (ORCID 0009-0001-9320-500X), v1.0, 30 September 2026. Full resolution of Meroni’s 2023 exposed-point conjecture: complex Zariski closure is irreducible for every finite sum of ellipsoidal discs of ranks at least two, without genericity or full dimensionality. A separate general-position theorem identifies it with the purely nonlinear part, resolving Gesmundo–Meroni’s 2022 generic conjecture. Earlier partial results and the standard analytic lemma are credited; no historical first-priority claim. Exact checks reproduced, extensive independent AI mathematical/priority audits and two fresh full-package review rounds completed, with all findings resolved. Unrefereed; extensive generative-AI use disclosed; no human peer review or formal certification claimed. PDF plus source/verification/review archive; prose CC BY 4.0, code MIT. Primary problem source: https://doi.org/10.4171/OWR/2023/15, p.830, Conjecture 1. Record: https://zenodo.org/records/23074543. Reviewed PR: https://github.com/AlecKriebel/Math/pull/9.
